item.title: Inspired by true stories
item.description: Inspired by true stories I was sick yesterday, and when I’m sick I like to watch movies. I ended up on a “based on a true story” kick and watched three movies I found particularly inspirational: “The Finest Hours”, “Chasing Mavericks”, and “Flamin’ Hot”. I find I really enjoy movies like this, and I really don’t mind how loosely or closely the film is based on factual events. They’re usually inspirational stories grounded in enough truth to be plausible.
